rainbow_smelt.season_2026: 2026 rules (2027 handbook/orders unpublished; assumed to repeat): Tidal angling Aug 1-May 31 (closed Jun 1-Jul 31); dip net Apr 1-Jun 15 except Fri/Sat/Sun; spear tidal waters only, all year; inland angling only while a sportfish season is open. Dip net and spear banned all year in waters flowing into Lingan Bay and at Bain's Brook / Morrison's Brook (Victoria Co.). (Handbook p.12; DFO Maritimes diadromous page)
rainbow_smelt.limits_2026: 60/day by angling or spear; max 30 by dip net (DFO page; MPFR s.87 says 60 any method - DFO 30 dip-net figure applied).
rainbow_smelt.licence: none-tidal (no licence for tidal angling or dip-netting); NS-general for inland angling
rainbow_smelt.notes: Jan-Mar = through-the-ice angling in tidal Bras d'Or water - ice-dependent and only on safe ice (>=10 cm clear ice). Apr-May peak = spring spawning run after ice-out (timing inferred from Maine/Ontario biology; no NS run data). Oct-Dec wharf angling is legal (season) but no local evidence of abundance. River Denys Basin is closed to TROUT Oct 1-Mar 31 and to ALL angling Apr 1-30 - no smelt fishing there in April.

gaspereau.season_2026: 2026 rules (2027 handbook/orders unpublished; assumed to repeat): Tidal angling: no closed season. Inland angling only during a sportfish season. Dip net (Richmond/Cape Breton side, MPFR Sched. V items 14-15): open Mar 15-Jul 10, weekly close 08:00 Friday to 08:00 Sunday; no inland non-angling methods sunset to sunrise (s.43). Gulf-side Inverness/Victoria tidal: weekly close 18:00 Fri-18:00 Sun; Antigonish: 14:00 Fri-14:00 Sun.
gaspereau.limits_2026: 20/day, angling and dip net combined (MPFR s.41.1). Never within 23 m downstream of a fish ladder or leap.
gaspereau.licence: none-tidal (no licence for dip-netting anywhere); NS-general for inland angling
gaspereau.notes: Run May to early July (DFO Gulf SAR 2022/014, regional). Large 2026 run evidenced by a 3,854 lb seizure at the Grand River fish ladder (June 1, 2026) No fishing within 23 m below any fishway.

sea_run_brook_trout.season_2026: 2026 rules (2027 handbook/orders unpublished; assumed to repeat): RFA 1/2 tidal Apr 15-Sep 30 (Sep 1-30 no brook trout retained, no natural bait). Richmond listed rivers (River Inhabitants below Kingsville Hwy 105 bridge, Grand River, Framboise, River Tillard) Apr 15-Sep 30, closed to all angling Apr 1-14. River Denys STMA closed Apr 1-30, open May 1. West River STMA (Antigonish) from May 15. Grand River STMA: single-hook lure/fly Apr 15-May 31, fly only Jun 1-Sep 30.
sea_run_brook_trout.limits_2026: General 5/day; River Denys 3/day only 1 >35 cm; Grand River STMA 1 trout >35 cm; West River STMA 1 trout >=35 cm.
sea_run_brook_trout.licence: none-tidal (tidal reaches); NS-general above inland boundaries
sea_run_brook_trout.notes: Trophy, not numbers: River Denys catches >30 cm rose 47%->70% (RFAC 2016); Antigonish West River first-week catch ~0.10 trout/angler-hour 1991-2007. Release any salmon or parr at once.

stocked_trout.season_2026: 2026 rules (2027 handbook/orders unpublished; assumed to repeat): Inland RFA 1/2 Apr 1-Sep 30 (Sep: no brook trout kept, no natural bait). Extended all-year lakes (2/day Oct 1-Mar 31): Eco-Trail Pond (Isle Madame), Petite Lac, #20 Dam Pond, Grant's Pond, Goose Harbour, McKeen, Pringle, Cameron, Copper, Gillis lakes; trophy Stewart and Dalem lakes 2/day all year.
stocked_trout.limits_2026: 5/day combined brook/brown/rainbow in season; 2/day Oct 1-Mar 31 on extended-season lakes.
stocked_trout.notes: Abundance = hatchery supply: province expects to 'return to the regular spring schedule in 2027' after the 2026 drought cut (no rainbows in 2026). Spring stocking dates in 2026 ran May-June; fall 'Winter Fishery' rainbows went into Antigonish and Guysborough lakes in 2023-25. Fish the first weeks after stocking.

wild_brook_trout.season_2026: 2026 rules (2027 handbook/orders unpublished; assumed to repeat): RFA 1 inland Apr 1-Sep 30 (Sep 1-30 no brook trout kept, natural bait banned for all trout). Cape Breton Highlands STMA open all year, bait allowed.
wild_brook_trout.limits_2026: 5/day; Highlands STMA 10 brook trout/day (small, stunted fish).
wild_brook_trout.notes: Peak in cool water May-June; July-Aug warm-water stress (fish early mornings). Survey records are presence-only and mostly 1970s-80s. Brook trout spawn Oct-Nov: release fall fish.

brown_trout.season_2026: 2026 rules (2027 handbook/orders unpublished; assumed to repeat): Margaree STMA Apr 15-Oct 31 (closed Apr 1-14; fly only from Jun 1, 6 am-10 pm); SW Margaree Scotsville bridge to Forks Apr 15-Oct 31; tidal Bras d'Or all year (see rainbow_brown_trout_bras_dor).
brown_trout.limits_2026: Margaree STMA 5 brown/rainbow per day, no size limit; general 5/day elsewhere in season.
brown_trout.notes: Anglers in the spring 2026 MSA survey reported 2-3 browns per salmon (reported). Margaree Warm Water Protocol closures stop ALL species; check DFO Gulf notices. DFO proposed (Handbook p.3) tighter Margaree STMA gear rules - may change in 2027. Salmon parr look like small browns: 'If you don't know, let it go!'

rainbow_brown_trout_bras_dor_tidal.season_2026: 2026 rules (2027 handbook/orders unpublished; assumed to repeat): Tidal Bras d'Or Lakes, St. Patrick's and St. Andrews channels: OPEN ALL YEAR, ANY GEAR, excluding closed areas (Baddeck R. above Hwy 105; inside East Bay Sandbar; above Black River bridge, Dundee; above Crowdis Bridge; above MacKenzie Brook bridge). Inside the Boom Channel incl. River Denys Basin closed to trout Oct 1-Mar 31 and to all angling Apr 1-30.
rainbow_brown_trout_bras_dor_tidal.limits_2026: 5/day Apr-Sep, 2/day Oct 1-Mar 31; rainbow trout min 35 cm all year. Brook trout: release after Sep 30. Sportfish: 1 line/3 hooks; no angling 2 h after sunset to 2 h before sunrise.
rainbow_brown_trout_bras_dor_tidal.licence: NS-general (handbook says none needed in tidal water but groups Bras d'Or with inland waters; 2012 NS release says winter fishing needs a General licence - carry one)
rainbow_brown_trout_bras_dor_tidal.notes: No abundance evidence: the fishery historically relied on aquaculture escapes that have declined; trophy records exist (11.33 lb rainbow, 2021).

striped_bass_maritimes_side.season_2026: 2026 rules (2027 handbook/orders unpublished; assumed to repeat): Atlantic/Bras d'Or side of the Canso Causeway (Inhabitants Bay, Port Hawkesbury, Lennox Passage, St. Peter's, Isle Madame, Bras d'Or): tidal open all year except Dec 30-31 (MPFR s.91); inland waters only during the sportfish season (closed Oct 1-Apr 14).
striped_bass_maritimes_side.notes: Peak Oct-mid-Nov is guide anecdote (The Fisherman 2020). Use circle hooks; release big fish. Causeway boundary is inferred from DFO zone descriptions.

striped_bass_gulf_side.season_2026: 2026 rules (2027 handbook/orders unpublished; assumed to repeat): Gulf side (Creignish north to Cape North; Auld's Cove west, St. Georges Bay): tidal Apr 15-Oct 31; NS inland May 1-Sep 15. Hours: Apr 15-Jun 30 from 2 h before sunrise to 2 h after sunset; Jul 1-Oct 31 04:00-00:00.
striped_bass_gulf_side.limits_2026: 4/day and 4 in possession, 50-65 cm total length; single barbless hooks mandatory in tidal waters (up to 5 lines, 6 single barbless hooks per line).
striped_bass_gulf_side.notes: 2027 Gulf notice not yet issued (2026 notice dated Apr 14, 2026). Peak months are guide anecdote.

atlantic_mackerel.season_2026: 2026 rules (2027 handbook/orders unpublished; assumed to repeat): All Maritimes tidal waters Apr 1-Dec 31 (AFR close Jan 1-Mar 31).
atlantic_mackerel.limits_2026: 20/day and in possession; no minimum size (MAR-VAR-2025-071, stated for 2025-2026); 1 line with no more than 3 hooks (MAR-VAR-2025-102).
atlantic_mackerel.notes: DFO species profile: northern contingent spawns in the southern Gulf June-July, then feeds across Atlantic Canada 'from the end of July to October or November'; most landings June-October. No St. Peter's/Strait-specific arrival data. Stock near Critical Zone - keep only what you eat. 2027 size/gear orders unknown.

groundfish_maritimes_side.season_2026: 2026 rules (2027 handbook/orders unpublished; assumed to repeat): Hartlen Point east to Cape North incl. Bras d'Or Lakes: 3rd Saturday in June to end of Labour Day (= Jun 19-Sep 6, 2027 if repeated). DFO page dated 2023-07-31; no Maritimes recreational groundfish variation order located.
groundfish_maritimes_side.limits_2026: 5 groundfish/day aggregate; handline or angling only; no halibut, northern or spotted wolffish retained. AFR Sched. I Pt II 'groundfish' includes cod, haddock, pollock, winter flounder, cunner, sculpin, ocean pout, lumpfish, dogfish, skate.
groundfish_maritimes_side.notes: Based on a 2023 DFO page; no 2026 order was found, so check DFO before keeping any. Treat cunner, flounder, pollock and sculpin as keepable only in the window; release outside it.

groundfish_gulf_side.season_2026: 2026 rules (2027 handbook/orders unpublished; assumed to repeat): Within 50 m of the coast, NB border to Auld's Cove wharf and old Creignish wharf to Cape North: Apr 15-Jul 31 and Sep 6-Oct 1, 2026; Aug 1-Sep 5, 2026 sunrise to sunset. Other NS 4T waters Aug 1-Sep 5 only. Order GVO-2026-011 revokes Jan 1, 2027.
groundfish_gulf_side.limits_2026: 15 groundfish aggregate. Apr 15-Jul 31 & Sep 6-Oct 1: zero cod, white hake, haddock, pollock, skate, halibut, wolffish. Aug 1-Sep 5: may include up to 5 cod and/or white hake; zero skate, halibut, wolffish.
groundfish_gulf_side.notes: Cunner and flounder are not named in the order but are 'groundfish of all species' (AFR), so keepable from shore/wharves from Apr 15 within 50 m (inferred). 2027 order expected ~mid-April 2027.

winter_flounder.season_2026: 2026 rules (2027 handbook/orders unpublished; assumed to repeat): Groundfish rules apply. Atlantic/Bras d'Or side: 3rd Sat June-Labour Day only. Gulf side within 50 m of shore: Apr 15-Oct 1 per GVO-2026-011 periods.
winter_flounder.limits_2026: Counts in the groundfish aggregate: 5/day (Maritimes side), 15/day (Gulf side).
winter_flounder.notes: No Cape Breton abundance/timing data found; months inferred. May and September only legal on the Gulf side.

pollock.season_2026: 2026 rules (2027 handbook/orders unpublished; assumed to repeat): Atlantic/Bras d'Or side: groundfish window 3rd Sat June-Labour Day. Gulf side: retention only Aug 1-Sep 5 (zero pollock Apr 15-Jul 31 and Sep 6-Oct 1).
pollock.limits_2026: In the groundfish aggregate (5/day Maritimes side; 15/day Gulf side Aug 1-Sep 5).
pollock.notes: No local abundance data; summer wharf/ledge fish inferred.

cunner.season_2026: 2026 rules (2027 handbook/orders unpublished; assumed to repeat): Cunner is legally 'groundfish' (AFR Schedule I Part II). Atlantic/Bras d'Or side: treat as open only 3rd Sat June-Labour Day (DFO page does not list cunner - unconfirmed). Gulf side within 50 m: Apr 15-Oct 1 periods.
cunner.limits_2026: In the groundfish aggregate (5/day Maritimes side; 15/day Gulf side).
cunner.notes: Classic kids' wharf fish; no abundance data. Release outside the window on the Maritimes side.

white_perch.season_2026: 2026 rules (2027 handbook/orders unpublished; assumed to repeat): Coincides with an open sportfish season (RFA 1 inland Apr 1-Sep 30); RFA 2 all-year perch lakes: Cameron, Copper, Gillis, Goose Harbour, Goshen, McKeen, Pringle, Gairloch; winter lakes open for trout are also open for perch.
white_perch.limits_2026: 10/day (reduced from 25 in 2026). May not be used or possessed as bait.
white_perch.notes: Presence confirmed in 59 survey waters incl. Lauchlin, Buchanan, Victoria, Grand, Sec, Shaw, Pottie, Long, Cranberry lakes (Richmond); records 1956-2010, presence only. Peak months inferred (warm-water species).

yellow_perch.season_2026: 2026 rules (2027 handbook/orders unpublished; assumed to repeat): Coincides with a sportfish season (Apr 1-Sep 30); all year in listed RFA 2 lakes (Cameron, Copper, Gillis, Goose Harbour, Goshen, McKeen, Pringle, Gairloch).
yellow_perch.limits_2026: 25/day. May not be used or possessed as bait.
yellow_perch.notes: Survey records only on the mainland side (Guysborough/Antigonish, 44+ km from Cleveland); none on Cape Breton Island in the extract. Winter months = ice fishing on all-year lakes only where ice is safe.

smallmouth_bass.season_2026: 2026 rules (2027 handbook/orders unpublished; assumed to repeat): RFA 1 and 2: season coincides with trout season (inland Apr 1-Sep 30).
smallmouth_bass.limits_2026: MANDATORY RETENTION - every smallmouth caught must be kept and humanely killed; never transport live or use as bait.
smallmouth_bass.notes: Illegally introduced; records Lake Ainslie (2004-2017) and Blacketts Lake (CBRM); spreading into SW Margaree (MSA eDNA). Peak months inferred.

chain_pickerel.season_2026: 2026 rules (2027 handbook/orders unpublished; assumed to repeat): Season coincides with trout season (inland Apr 1-Sep 30).
chain_pickerel.limits_2026: MANDATORY RETENTION province-wide; report new waters to ReportAIS@novascotia.ca / 902-485-5056.
chain_pickerel.notes: Only Cape Breton records are Blacketts and Gillis lakes (CBRM, ~84 km from Cleveland) - outside this map's area.

american_eel.season_2026: 2026 rules (2027 handbook/orders unpublished; assumed to repeat): Tidal: no closed season. Inland: only during a sportfish season.
american_eel.limits_2026: Maritimes side 10/day, min 35 cm; Gulf side 5/day, min 53 cm. ELVERS: 'Unauthorized harvest, possession or export of elver is illegal' - licensed commercial/First Nations fishery only.
american_eel.notes: COSEWIC Threatened (2012) - encourage release. Peak months inferred. Present in 51 survey waters incl. Whites Lake (8 km).

american_shad.season_2026: 2026 rules (2027 handbook/orders unpublished; assumed to repeat): Tidal: no closed season. Inland: only during a sportfish season.
american_shad.notes: Minor; one survey record in region. No run data.

landlocked_salmon.season_2026: 2026 rules (2027 handbook/orders unpublished; assumed to repeat): Goose Harbour Lake (Guysborough) OPEN ALL YEAR; Gabarus Lake Apr 15-Sep 30; otherwise closed all year.
landlocked_salmon.limits_2026: 2/day, min 35 cm fork length; release all over 63 cm.
landlocked_salmon.notes: Goose Harbour Lake (Guysborough) has the only nearby landlocked salmon season, but its only road is private and the lake is an industrial water supply, so it is not on this map. Numbers unknown.

atlantic_salmon.season_2026: 2026 rules (2027 handbook/orders unpublished; assumed to repeat): Catch-and-release, barbless artificial fly only, Jun 1-Oct 31 in open waters only: Margaree system Jun 1-Oct 15 (main stems to Oct 31; NE Margaree above Big Intervale closed all year); Middle and Baddeck Oct 1-31; North River below The Benches Jun 1-Jul 14 & Sep 1-Oct 31; SFA 18 rivers (West and South rivers, Antigonish; Mabou) Sep 1-Oct 31. ALL OTHER SFA 19 WATERS CLOSED ALL YEAR (River Inhabitants, Grand River, Framboise, River Tillard, River Bourgeois etc.). VOs MAR-VAR-2026-093/094/095 in force to May 31, 2027.
atlantic_salmon.limits_2026: Zero retention; daily release limit 4 (SFA 18) / 2 (SFA 19). Margaree Warm Water Protocol can close all species.
atlantic_salmon.licence: NS-salmon (online only; return stub within 7 days of season close)
atlantic_salmon.notes: Not abundant: assessed Endangered by COSEWIC (December 2025), with a federal species-at-risk listing decision pending. Catch-and-release on the few open rivers only; closed everywhere else, including River Inhabitants.
